label: Codex Arundel
summary: Bound collection of loose sheets of Leonardo's notes and drawings, British Library, London, Arundel MS 263.
dimensions: c. 205 x 290 mm (British Library catalogue, as reported)
history: Thomas Howard, Earl of Arundel, c.1630 or c.1636
presented to the Royal Society 1667 by Henry Howard

claims.statement: The British Library catalogue describes one paper codex of 283 folios, foliated 283 + 100* + 101*, c. 205 x 290 mm.

sources.cite: British Library, Archives and Manuscripts catalogue, Arundel MS 263 (seen only as a search summary: 1 paper codex, 283 folios, foliation 283 + 100* + 101*, c. 205 x 290 mm, full digital coverage, Royal Society stamp on f. 2r, presented 1667 by Henry Howard, 6th Duke of Norfolk; host blocked for direct fetch in this session).

value.text: Note: begun in Florence in the house of Piero di Braccio Martelli, 22 March 1508

claims.statement: An autograph note states that the collection was begun in Florence in the house of Piero di Braccio Martelli on 22 March 1508, as a collection without order drawn from many sheets copied there. Italian text and folio to be taken from the edition; the English wording here is from a secondary source and is a translation.
